searchQuery.title: Search Query
searchQuery.description: The keyword to search for on EuroPages (e.g. 'construction', 'doors', 'furniture')

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Direct EuroPages listing or company detail URLs to scrape. If provided, searchQuery is ignored.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of companies to scrape (0 = unlimited)

maxPages.title: Max Listing Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of search result pages to crawl for company links

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Recommended for large-scale scraping to avoid blocks.
